grades.lower_bound_mechanism: Killing property (K'): descent on pi through private members + pigeonhole on prime-sets of product <= a_1, giving no infinite minimal transversal (compactness), then peeling to force C finite
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: L = lcm of the finitely many minimal elements; S_inf membership is L-periodic for every m, T = #(S_inf ∩ [a_1, a_1+L)), block bijection gives a_{n+T}=a_n+L for all n>=1
grades.notes: Complete, self-contained argument. Step 1 gives the characterization; Steps 3-4 prove finiteness of minimal supports via intersecting antichain, finite self-duality, killing property (K'), compactness and peeling; Step 2 gives periodicity from n=1. Only blemish: C is really the family of *finite* minimal transversals, but this is harmless (antichain reproved via divisibility).
